channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Avalanche of G.O.P. Cash Keeps the Party Competitive Despite Its Problems
item.description: Republican Senate and House candidates are being out-raised by their Democratic rivals, but the party has received a huge boost from groups tied to Elon Musk and President Trump.

item.title: NPR: Crowds throng New Delhi and wave Indian flags amid escalating protests
item.description: Protests have intensified over a review of voter lists that critics say is politically motivated and threatens to disenfranchise voters. The Election Commission and Modi's administration deny these allegations.

item.title: BBC News: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls refinery strikes a 'disgrace'
item.description: EU leaders rally around Ukraine's leader after Donald Trump says he is "more difficult to work with than Putin".

item.title: The Guardian: Fiery speeches, LED hats and infighting: inside an Alberta separatist conference

item.title: Al Jazeera: Qatar FM calls for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon
item.description: Qatar’s prime minister and minister of foreign affairs has reaffirmed his country’s support for Lebanon.

item.title: Ars Technica: The Surface Laptop Ultra delivers on most of Microsoft's promises
item.description: Microsoft promises one machine for dev, AI, and gaming, and mostly gets there.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: cool kids are writing in all lowercase now. does that make you mad?
item.description: a certain kind of person writes in all lowercase now. why?

item.title: WIRED Science: Egypt’s Climate-Resilient ‘Super Corals’ Are Starting to Feel the Heat
item.description: Scientists can’t agree why reefs in the Red Sea have long been immune to bleaching. The answer could be the key to saving these tough corals as climate change begins taking its toll.

item.title: WIRED Business: We Got Hot and Heavy With Meta’s Muse—and Baffled by Apple’s HomeView
item.description: This week on “Uncanny Valley,” we dive into an unexpected Muse feature, shadowy spending from the largest pro-AI super PAC, and men’s tendency to lie about how much they know about AI.

item.title: The New Yorker: Facing the Death Penalty
item.description: The cases of Christa Pike and Nidal Hasan show how vanishingly fine the line is between a routine execution and an unbearable one.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: What We Know About the Oregon School Shooting
item.description: The 16-year-old suspect was killed by a bystander shortly before police arrived at the scene.

item.description: On a scale from the Chrysler Building to the Morgan Library, what is the comedian and drag king’s NYQ?
